extraction.notes: Q4 2025 (three months ended 12/31/2025) column from S-8. Company reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. FFO subtotal 22,318 is the 'FFO applicable to common shares and Units' line (before Series D distributions); the diluted FFO of 22,375 is not used as a subtotal. Core subtotal 24,567 likewise precedes the Series D distribution add-back. Diluted shares 19,699 reproduce reported per-share figures: 22,375/19,699 = $1.14 and 24,624/19,699 = $1.25. Recurring capex: the only disclosure is 'Total Recurring Capital Expenditures per Apartment Home - Same-Store' of $269 on S-15, a per-home figure with no total dollar amount, so recurring_capex_disclosed is set to null rather than mixing units. 'Legal and other costs related to strategic review' (1,336) was classified as transaction_costs; it could alternatively be classed as legal. The 'Interest rate swap amortization' line is printed as an em dash (zero) in the Q4 2025 column. Line 'Less depreciation - partially owned entities' is printed as an em dash (zero) in Q4 2025.
